systems.system: National Registration Bureau district offices on the Government Wide Area Network
systems.owner: National Registration Bureau, a department of the Ministry of Homeland Security
systems.tiers: all 28 district NRB offices online via the Government Wide Area Network by 2020, sending data in real time to the central database; the offices are the Bureau's, supervised by the District Commissioner as District Registrar
reached the National Registration Bureau's offices in all 28 districts by 2020; no council office is said to be on it

note: The plan says all 28 district offices of the National Registration Bureau were online on the government network by 2020. These are a national agency's field offices, class central, so no fact is recorded; local authorities appear only as intermediaries for community awareness and reporting.
